title: Matt LaFleur on Micah Parsons: As soon as they give us the green light, he'll be out there

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur on Micah Parsons: As soon as they give us the green light, he'll be out there
sources.description: Earlier in the day, reporting out of ESPN indicated Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons is not expected to return to practice this week as he continues to recover from a torn ACL suffered late last season.
